capabilities: Insert and open textfold:// links to papers, paragraphs, notes and zoom levels
Hover-preview linked passages and drag TextFold items into notes as callouts, quotes or links
List a note's TextFold citations and the linked documents' highlights and conversations in a sidebar
Fold, export and refold the current note in Obsidian at TextFold's five zoom levels
Import a TextFold document's notes into the vault and update them on re-import
disambiguation: Not a text-folding or outlining utility; it bridges notes to the TextFold reader app, whose five zoom levels it also mirrors inside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only. Full features (hover previews, dragging from the reader, refold in place) need TextFold 0.10.18 or later; older versions get reduced behaviour. Folding and translation run through the model set up in TextFold at the user's cost. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link notes to papers kept in TextFold or to bring its highlights, comments and model answers into a note.
